summary.intent: Enhance the summary TUI detail pane to show all available session data (scores, stats, files, tool usage, facet evidence), fix the repo filter showing nothing, implement the wizard edit action, and add clipboard copy support.
summary.outcome: All goals achieved: detail pane now shows 4 grouped boxes (SUMMARY, CODE, LEARNINGS, SIGNALS) with full data and spacing; repo filter loads its own 200 sessions independently; wizard edit opens a huh form; y key copies detail pane to clipboard with mouse scroll preserved.

repo: The summary TUI loads only 200 most recent sessions; the repo filter was broken because those 200 sessions were all from unmerged feature branches with no overlap with main-reachable checkpoint IDs.

Facets (friction, failure loops, repeated instructions, etc.) are extracted via LLM on first access and cached in insights.db with has_facets=0/1; backfilling is the LLM extraction pass over sessions that lack facets.
WizardIntentEdit existed in the TUI but had no backend handler in memory_loop_cmd.go; the CLI edit path was also a stub ('not yet implemented').
tea.WithMouseCellMotion() captures all mouse events and prevents terminal text selection for copy; Option/Shift bypass did not work for this user.

code.finding: branchRows and repoRows are now separate slices; applyFilter swaps between them based on active filter, each independently capped at 200 sessions
New QueryByCheckpointIDs method added to load sessions filtered to a set of checkpoint IDs, used by the repo filter path
renderSubSection takes currentLen int param to insert blank line separator before non-first sub-sections; renderDetailPlainText uses plain styles for clipboard export
editMemoryLoopWizardRequest function added: finds record by ID in state, opens huh form pre-populated with title/body/keywords, calls EditRecord on submit

workflow: Codex adversarial review companion hits ENOBUFS on large repos — the git diff output exceeds the internal buffer; not usable on large monorepos.
When both branchRows and repoRows need to be populated in tests, pass the same sample rows to both params to avoid nil-slice filter failures.
pbcopy (macOS) / xclip/xsel (Linux) used for clipboard via exec.Command; no external Go clipboard dependency needed.

friction: Codex adversarial review companion failed with ENOBUFS on both foreground and background runs due to repo size.
replace_all on renderSubSection call sites corrupted the parameter order (len(allLines) ended up as the title argument), requiring manual correction.
Removing tea.WithMouseCellMotion() broke scroll; re-adding it and adding a y-to-copy workaround was needed to satisfy both requirements simultaneously.
newRootModel test call sites required updating across multiple test files after the repoRows parameter was added.
open_items: The editMemoryMsg type in the TUI is defined but never used — the edit flow goes through the wizard handler, not through a TUI-internal message.
The Codex adversarial review tool is unusable on this repo until the ENOBUFS buffer limit is increased.
Clipboard copy uses pbcopy/xclip shell commands; a proper cross-platform Go clipboard library could replace this in the future.
